title: Super-Webdesigner showcase: three directions
subtitle: Gray skeletons: judge the composition. The only color is the swatch strip. Same copy in all three.

directions.why: Proof-white page, press-black type, and an art director's red pencil marking up the other agents' page.
directions.from: the pages people remember make the product the hero and keep the rest quiet.
desktop: RED PENCIL MARKUP ON THE TELLS
directions.paletteNames: proof white · press black · red pencil · proof gray
directions.fonts: Schibsted Grotesk 800 (titles) · IBM Plex Mono (commands, labels) · Caveat Brush (only the pencil notes)
directions.logo: the wordmark Super-Webdesigner with a red proofreader's caret (‸) inserted between Super and Webdesigner, as if an editor added it.
directions.wildcard: on the Other agents side, red pencil circles and handwritten notes ('glow', 'emoji?', 'again?') sit on top of the tells. They are clipped with that side, so dragging the line literally erases the bad page and its markup.

directions.why: Every AI page is dark. This one is built from big flat color chips, like a printer's swatch book, each with its code.
directions.from: dark mode, glass and glow are the niche's default; color fields are the opposite.
desktop: SW-002 · INK · SAME PROMPT, TWO AGENTS
CHIP LABEL WITH A CODE ON EVERY BLOCK
order: The flow as a chip strip
directions.paletteNames: tomato · cobalt · butter · ink · chip white
directions.logo: a small swatch chip: color top, white strip with 'SW' and the code 'SW-001'.
directions.favicon: the chip, tomato on top, white band below.
directions.wildcard: every block carries a swatch label with a code (SW-001 TOMATO, SW-002 INK...), so the page reads like a printed color book.

directions.why: A museum room: the two sites hang as framed works on a white wall, with small wall labels. The slider is the big frame in the middle.
directions.from: nobody in the niche shows work like art; the calm wall label is the opposite of a feature grid.
desktop: HTML on screen. Drag the line.
directions.paletteNames: gallery wall · frame black · oak floor · museum green
directions.logo: the wordmark set inside a thin square frame with a white mat, like a small framed print.
directions.favicon: a black square frame with a white mat and a green dot.
directions.wildcard: museum wall labels next to each work, with a lot number and a line like 'Please drag' instead of 'Do not touch'.
